name: webhook-action
description: POST agent lifecycle events to an HTTP endpoint. Supports method/headers overrides and a templated body.
author: PersonalClaw

provider.label: Send agent events to a webhook

x-meta.label: Webhook URL
x-meta.help: The https endpoint the event is POSTed to when this trigger fires. A plain http URL is refused unless it is on this machine (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1), since the event and its headers would travel unencrypted. A webhook URL is a credential: whoever has it can post to it. In a scheduled or event automation, enter it as {{secret:NAME}}, a secret saved in Settings → Secrets, so it is filled in only when the event is sent and is never kept in the automation. A lifecycle hook fills it from PersonalClaw 0.3.5.

x-meta.label: Headers (JSON)
x-meta.help: Optional JSON object of extra request headers. In a scheduled or event automation, enter a credential in one as {{secret:NAME}}, a secret saved in Settings → Secrets, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer {{secret:MY_TOKEN}}"}: it is filled in only when the event is sent. Content-Type defaults to application/json. A lifecycle hook fills it from PersonalClaw 0.3.5.

x-meta.label: Body template
x-meta.help: Optional. Template with $EVENT, $CONTEXT, $now, $job_name, etc. Leave blank to send the full event JSON as-is.
